fields.summary_ko.0: Some analysts have proposed target prices of KRW 70,000 for Samsung Electronics and KRW 200,000 for SK Hynix, suggesting potential additional declines of 62% and 82% respectively from current levels, raising concerns of losses up to KRW 18 million on a KRW 100 million investment in SK Hynix.
fields.summary_ko.1: If memory price declines become certain, semiconductor companies' earnings outlooks for 2027–2028 are expected to be significantly revised downward; however, TrendForce predicts supply-demand imbalances will persist through 2027 due to AI data center investments and HBM supply shortages.
